description: TY2026: an SSTB inside the widened band. MFJ, $450,000 K-1 (consulting), business W-2 wages $60,000. TI before QBI 417,800; excess over the $403,500 threshold = 14,300 of the $150,000 joint band -> applicable % = 135,700/150,000. Scaled QBI 407,100 (tentative 81,420), scaled W-2 54,280 (limit 27,140); reduction (81,420-27,140) x 14,300/150,000 = 5,174.69 -> deduction $76,245.31. TI = 341,554.69 -> tax $67,169.13 (no SE/Medicare on the K-1).
